schema_note: source_date null = not captured. open_source null = not applicable or not verified. verification: primary | secondary | vendor-claim | vendor-reported | github-api. X-only claims are excluded.

entries.name: OpenID Foundation Agent Auth (AAuth) Working Group
entries.description: OpenID Foundation working group on agent identity, person identity, authorization, delegation, discovery and lifecycle for agents acting across trust domains.

entries.name: Agent Name Service (ANS)
entries.description: Open standard for naming, registering and verifying AI agents using DNS and existing certificates; now hosted by the Linux Foundation.

entries.name: IETF WIMSE: AI agent authentication and authorization (draft-ietf-wimse-aims)
entries.description: Internet-Draft describing how WIMSE workload identity and OAuth 2.0 can be applied to authenticate and authorize AI agent interactions.

entries.name: MCP Authorization (2026-07-28 spec)
entries.description: Model Context Protocol authorization section; November 2026 docs rework makes Client ID Metadata Documents the primary client-registration method and deprecates Dynamic Client Registration.
entries.note: Exact merge date not captured; the PR page and a secondary write-up (vibecoding.inc) agree on the content.

entries.name: OAuth Identity Assertion JWT Authorization Grant (ID-JAG)
entries.description: IETF OAuth draft that lets an app or agent exchange a user's identity assertion for a scoped access token at another app's authorization server; the basis of Okta Cross App Access.
entries.note: Draft revision 06 seen; publish date not captured.

entries.name: Web Bot Auth
entries.description: Proposal to authenticate bot and agent HTTP traffic with public-key HTTP Message Signatures (RFC 9421) and a key directory; used as the base of Visa and Mastercard agent protocols.
entries.note: Source date is the Cloudflare/Visa/Mastercard announcement post-date per Cloudflare press release; reference code at github.com/cloudflare/web-bot-auth (Apache-2.0, pushed 2026-11-24).

entries.name: ERC-8004: Trustless Agents
entries.description: Ethereum standard defining on-chain Identity, Reputation and Validation registries so agents can be discovered and assessed across organizations.
entries.note: Publish date not captured. The 8004.org learn page notes the Validation Registry was not yet available when read; status may have changed.

entries.name: Accountable Agents Framework (AAF)
entries.description: Proposed blueprint for privacy-preserving, directory-issued agent IDs that tie an agent to an accountable person or organization; a paper, not a deployed service.
entries.note: Paper exists and was read via search summary. A Nov 24, 2026 launch date appears only in an X trending summary, so it is NOT used here.

entries.name: OVERT standard
entries.description: Standard (v1.1) for producing independently verifiable evidence that runtime AI controls ran as declared, without exposing protected content.
entries.note: Publication month not captured in the excerpt read.

entries.name: Agent Execution Receipts (AER-1)
entries.description: IETF individual Internet-Draft by B. Zambo defining signed execution receipts for agent tool calls so a third party can recompute and check them.
entries.note: Date is the draft date stated in the author's own post (draft-zambo-aer1-26); the author discloses they work for the origin product. IETF datatracker page not opened.

entries.name: Aweb Agent Receipts
entries.description: Open-source draft spec for scoped execution grants, tool manifests and signed action receipts for agents that call MCP tools and APIs.
entries.note: Spec says it is a public draft not yet submitted to a standards body; date not captured.

entries.name: Verifiable Intent
entries.description: Draft SD-JWT credential format that binds an agent's purchases to the user's stated intent and limits; AP2-compatible and being donated to FIDO.
entries.note: Spec version 0.1-draft dated 2026-02-18. Google's Apr 28, 2026 post says it is being donated to FIDO.

entries.name: Agent Payments Protocol (AP2)
entries.description: Protocol for securing agent-performed payments with signed Checkout and Payment Mandates and receipts; donated by Google to the FIDO Alliance.
entries.note: v0.2 released Apr 28, 2026; GitHub repo google-agentic-commerce/AP2 Apache-2.0, last push 2026-06-17.

entries.name: x402 and the x402 Foundation
entries.description: Open HTTP 402-based payment protocol for agents and APIs; operational under the Linux Foundation with 40 member organizations as of July 2026.

entries.name: Agentic Commerce Protocol (ACP)
entries.description: Open protocol defining how agents create checkout sessions, exchange payment credentials and complete purchases.
entries.note: Repo Apache-2.0, last push 2026-07-18 (GitHub API, read 2026-11-24). Description follows the Verifiable Intent protocol-landscape page; announcement date not captured.

entries.name: Visa Trusted Agent Protocol
entries.description: Visa protocol, built with Cloudflare on HTTP Message Signatures and Web Bot Auth, that lets merchants recognize approved agents and their commerce intent.
entries.note: Reference repo github.com/visa/trusted-agent-protocol (license not asserted).

entries.name: KYAPay (Skyfire)
entries.description: Open JWT protocol with identity, payment and combined tokens so sellers can verify an agent and its pre-authorized payment.
entries.note: Docs read Nov 24, 2026; docs show no publish date.

entries.name: Okta for AI Agents and Cross App Access (XAA)
entries.description: Okta product line for registering agents, governing their access and issuing short-lived scoped tokens; now supports third-party identity providers via XAA.
entries.note: Press-release date not captured; third-party IdP support described as generally available.

entries.name: Descope Envoy
entries.description: Delegated sign-in path for personal AI agents on consumer sites, with granular permissions and out-of-band approval; launch partners include GoFundMe, You.com, GoodRx and Composio.

entries.name: IBM Agent Identity (HashiCorp Vault)
entries.description: IBM's approach to registering agents, delegating authority, authorizing access and auditing agent actions on HashiCorp Vault, extended by the AuthMind acquisition.

entries.name: AuthMind (now part of IBM)
entries.description: Identity observability company that maps how human, machine and agent identities use credentials; acquired by IBM in November 2026.

entries.name: Astrix Security (now part of Cisco)
entries.description: Security for AI agents and non-human identities (service accounts, API keys, OAuth tokens); acquisition closed by Cisco on June 29, 2026.
entries.note: Closing date from NHI Governance; Cisco's own announcement page (blogs.cisco.com) exists but was not opened. Reported price (~$400M, Calcalist) is not asserted here.

entries.name: C1.ai (now part of Workday)
entries.description: Agentic identity platform for people and AI agents; Workday completed its acquisition on Nov 23, 2026.

entries.name: Baselayer Agentic Identity Suite
entries.description: Business-identity company that added Know Your Agent, Counterparty Verification and a Trusted Registry for agents; raised a $35M Series A led by M13.

entries.name: Beltic
entries.description: Know Your Agent platform that verifies agents visiting a business and checks actions against the business's rules; $7.3M seed led by Norwest.

entries.name: t54 Labs
entries.description: Identity, risk and compliance infrastructure for agents that transact; reported $5M seed (Feb 2026) co-led by Anagram, PL Capital and Franklin Templeton.
entries.note: Funding details come from the wetheflywheel survey, which says it checked each round against the announcement; the primary announcement was not opened.

entries.name: AGNTCY
entries.description: Linux Foundation project for agent discovery (Directory), identity, messaging and observability; Directory and Identity are Apache-2.0.
entries.note: LF press date not captured; repos agntcy/dir (last push 2026-11-24) and agntcy/identity (2026-10-07).

entries.name: Solana Agent Registry
entries.description: Solana's implementation of ERC-8004 identity, reputation and verification registries for agents.
entries.note: Reported by ChainCatcher via KuCoin; primary Solana post not opened.

entries.name: Agent Passport System
entries.description: Open protocol and TypeScript SDK for agent identity, scoped delegation, enforcement before the action and signed receipts.
entries.note: Date is last push (GitHub API, read 2026-11-24). Apache-2.0, 67 stars.

entries.name: Casdoor
entries.description: Open-source identity and access management platform positioned as agent-first, with an LLM/MCP and agent gateway.
entries.note: Date is last push (GitHub API). Apache-2.0, ~14.9k stars.

entries.name: Microsoft Agent Governance Toolkit
entries.description: Open-source toolkit for policy enforcement, zero-trust identity, execution sandboxing and reliability for autonomous agents.
entries.note: Date is last push. MIT, ~6.6k stars.

entries.name: Tenuo
entries.description: Open-source task-scoped authorization for agents using cryptographic warrants that constrain tools and arguments.
entries.note: Date is last push. Apache-2.0, 109 stars.

entries.name: Cerbos
entries.description: Open-core authorization management platform that evaluates policy for human, service and agent identities.
entries.note: Date is last push. Apache-2.0, ~4.7k stars.

entries.name: Arcjet
entries.description: Runtime security SDK for apps and agents, including prompt-injection detection and tool-call authorization.
entries.note: Date is last push. Apache-2.0 SDK, 701 stars; the hosted service is a commercial product.

entries.name: Cloudflare signed agents
entries.description: Cloudflare identifies user-directed agents whose requests carry Web Bot Auth signatures and lets site owners write rules on them.
entries.note: Docs page read Nov 24, 2026; no publish date.

entries.name: Akamai Web Bot Auth verification
entries.description: Akamai verifies Web Bot Auth signatures at the edge and classifies validated agent traffic with customer-set allow, challenge, delay or block policies.
entries.note: Blog date not captured.

entries.name: Capsule Security
entries.description: Runtime security platform that monitors agent behavior in production and enforces policy; $7M seed led by Lama Partners (Apr 2026).

entries.name: EDAMAME
entries.description: French security company that monitors AI agents from outside the agent and describes itself as 'the AI agent trust layer'.
entries.note: Homepage title read 2026-11-24. The Nov 5, 2026 AWS Marketplace post is on LinkedIn, not re-opened tonight, so not asserted.

entries.name: Visa Intelligent Commerce and Agentic Ready
entries.description: Visa program for agent-initiated payments; Agentic Ready expanded to merchants, PSPs and acquirers on Nov 17, 2026 with 140+ participants.

entries.name: Mastercard Agent Pay
entries.description: Mastercard's agentic payments program using agentic tokens, agent registration and consumer controls; launched April 2025.
entries.note: Launch month from the URL path; explainer page is dated 'November, 2026'.

entries.name: Mastercard Agent Pay for Machines
entries.description: Early-access Mastercard offering for machine-to-machine agent payments using x402-style payment-required vouchers and approved budgets.

entries.name: Stripe Shared Payment Tokens
entries.description: Stripe primitive that lets an agent grant sellers a scoped, expiring right to use a customer's payment method; now carries Visa and Mastercard agentic tokens and BNPL tokens.
entries.note: Blog post date not captured; text says SPTs launched 'last year'.

entries.name: AWS Marketplace agentic payments (Bedrock AgentCore)
entries.description: AWS Marketplace now supports agents paying for x402 products through Amazon Bedrock AgentCore payments.

entries.name: Walmart Agent Gateway
entries.description: Walmart channel for agents to shop for customers with spend limits and approvals; first live integration is Meta's Muse for Black Friday.

entries.name: Agent402
entries.description: Open-source project describing itself as a payment and trust layer for agents to find, pay for and verify paid calls over x402 and MPP.
entries.note: Date is last push; 53 stars; self-described.

entries.name: internet-court
entries.description: Open-source skill that describes itself as a trust layer for agent-to-agent commerce with delegated permissions, x402 payments, escrow and dispute resolution.
entries.note: Date is last push; ~7.2k stars; license not asserted by GitHub; self-described.

entries.name: Skyfire
entries.description: Payments and Know Your Agent tokens for agents buying content and APIs; reported $9.5M total funding (2024).

entries.name: Agent Trust Layer (ATL) protocol
entries.description: Open protocol and demo for an optional, fail-open trust consult before an agent makes an x402 payment.
entries.note: Date is last push; MIT; 0 stars; one-developer project. Unrelated to this site.

entries.name: Salesforce Einstein Trust Layer
entries.description: Salesforce's built-in layer for Agentforce covering grounding, data masking, prompt-injection and toxicity defenses and audit logs; a different use of 'trust layer' (LLM data protection).
entries.note: Listed to show the other meaning of the phrase. Docs date not captured.

entries.name: CrowdStrike to acquire Zscaler
entries.description: Definitive all-stock agreement valuing Zscaler at about $43.9B, pitched as zero trust for AI and agentic applications.
entries.note: Announced, subject to closing conditions.

entries.name: Workday completes C1.ai acquisition
entries.description: Workday completed its acquisition of agentic identity platform C1.ai.
entries.note: Terms not captured.

entries.name: IBM acquires AuthMind
entries.description: IBM acquired identity-observability company AuthMind to extend HashiCorp Vault agent identity; terms undisclosed.

entries.name: Cisco completes Astrix Security acquisition
entries.description: Cisco closed its acquisition of agent and non-human identity security company Astrix on June 29, 2026.

entries.name: Baselayer $35M Series A
entries.description: Baselayer raised $35M led by M13 to extend its identity network to AI agents.

entries.name: Beltic $7.3M seed
entries.description: Beltic emerged from stealth with a $7.3M seed round led by Norwest for agent verification.

entries.name: Capsule Security $7M seed
entries.description: Capsule Security launched from stealth with a $7M seed led by Lama Partners alongside Forgepoint Capital International.
